notes.title: Bug fixes and minor improvements
notes.content:
Hello players,

Some bugs have been fixed, and we've received some great feedback that will lead to new improvements soon. In this update, a UI bug that caused text to disappear has been resolved, and the materials for the Dogs have been updated. We've also added fog to the scene and made small lighting adjustments.

Thank you for your attention. We hope you have fun! If you have any suggestions, feel free to reach out—we’d be happy to hear from you!
